issues: The unspecified location is not stated in the verses; keep it unpictured or clearly unspecified.

Dialogue excerpts omit words from their verses (for example, 1 Nephi 7:8 omits the intervening clause before “Behold ye are mine elder brethren,” and 1 Nephi 7:11 stops before “in delivering us…”). Quotations must be contiguous, exact excerpts; use separate excerpts around omissions.
The explicit-facts entry for 1 Nephi 7:14 says the Spirit “will soon cease,” but the source says “ceaseth soon”; do not recast the verse’s present-tense wording as a future event.
The summary says the family members pleaded “with them,” while the verse specifies they pleaded with Nephi’s brethren. Clarify the referent to avoid ambiguity.
